identifiers.workingTreeState: uncommitted; source artifacts below bind the observed UI

credentialHandling: The authorized local credential was consumed by the server-side adapter only; it was not exposed to the browser, recorded, or printed.
procedure: Built the current web bundle, started the Fastify API on loopback with the authorized local environment, exercised the overview-first map/list selection, neutral route drawer, route data, local variation surface, map-only restoration, clear-session reset, safety copy, and browser accessibility checks. No Azure or production endpoint was used.

checks.name: overview-first all-flight rendering
checks.procedure: Load the ready local live app without entering a callsign and inspect the map/list overview.

measurement.summary: 92 recorded routes shown in the overview and no callsign gate

checks.failureFallback: Keep the revised UAT record separate and do not claim overview acceptance.

checks.name: synchronized map and list selection
checks.procedure: Select one displayed live route from the full list and verify the selected HUD, map emphasis, and detail controls track the same flight.

measurement.summary: list selection synchronized the selected route, HUD, map, and drawers

checks.failureFallback: Retain the result as a failed revised UAT and do not upgrade older records.

checks.name: neutral route comparison surface
checks.procedure: Open the recorded route-options drawer and inspect its headings, ordering language, and absence of preference fields or winner terminology.

measurement.summary: route options were presented as recorded complete/incomplete facts without a winner claim

checks.failureFallback: Do not relabel or reuse retained rank-era UAT artifacts.

checks.name: route data and explicit resolution state
checks.procedure: Open Route Data for the selected live route and inspect ordered legs, exact endpoint names/codes, modeled distance labeling, and visible gap state.

measurement.summary: route data drawer rendered ordered resolved legs, full airport names with codes, and descriptive modeled distance

checks.failureFallback: Keep route data acceptance unresolved; never infer missing geometry or operational suitability.

checks.name: local variation boundary
checks.procedure: Open the optional variation drawer and inspect its explicit local computational-draft and unsaved boundary.

measurement.summary: variation surface was bounded, optional, local, and separate from recorded-route comparison

checks.failureFallback: Treat variation as optional and local; do not make it a required journey stage.

checks.name: map-only restore and clear-session behavior
checks.procedure: Enter Map only, restore the controls, then clear the session and verify the populated overview remains available.

measurement.summary: map-only restoration returned controls and clear-session restored the populated overview

checks.failureFallback: Keep the live UAT result separate and report the failed interaction explicitly.

checks.name: persistent safety wording
checks.procedure: Inspect the persistent safety notice and the overview/map copy for operational or winner claims.

measurement.summary: exact demonstration-only safety sentence present; no winner or operational recommendation observed

checks.failureFallback: Block any release claim until the exact safety boundary is restored.

checks.name: browser accessibility scan
checks.procedure: Run the installed browser axe scan against the live overview after the revised flow.
checks.failureFallback: Keep the revised UAT pending human accessibility review; zero axe violations does not prove assistive-technology acceptance.
